What benefit class is D4341 and which page of the brochure lists it?

D4341 (periodontal scaling and root planing, four or more teeth per quadrant) is a **Class B (intermediate)** procedure. The brochure lists it on **page 25**.

Source: 2026 GEHA dental plan brochure, page 25.
